definition: Formed beforehand without enough knowledge or consideration of particular facts.
author: Fyodor Dostoyevsky
quote: But to judge some people impartially we must renounce certain preconceived opinions and our habitual attitude to the ordinary people about us.
example_sentence: Travel challenged all her preconceived ideas about the city.
